thread:
alex: quick check — planning to start the v2 compatibility rollout next week. finalizing owners and a short checklist. can each team confirm owners and blockers? (cc @rachael @sam)
rachael: owner for SDKs here — i'll own the python & node SDK release. blocker: one failing integration test on auth header parsing. digging.
sam: infra owner — i'll coordinate canary infra and capacity. need to confirm dedicated pools for canary traffic.
juan: routing/model owner — we need eng-ml to sign off on fallback routing for model variants. pinged them, waiting reply.
mike: QA — will own migration smoke tests. question: is there an agreed deprecation header to return for v1 endpoints when deprecated?
alex: yes — use header `X-Redwood-Deprecation: v1; date=2026-05-15` and 429 + body after cutoff. sample response snippet: ```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Redwood-Deprecation: v1; date=2026-05-15
```
rachael: thanks. on the SDK side we'll add a deprecation warning on init and an opt-in compatibility mode flag: `compat.v1: true` for customers who need extra time. plan to ship patch by Tue.
sam: infra note — canary window proposed: Tue 06:00 -> Thu 06:00 UTC. need owners to confirm no high-risk deploys during that window.
juan: eng-ml confirmed fallback routing logic works with v2 codepaths, but we need a small env var toggle to flip on kv-cache behavior. won’t be a showstopper.
mike: tests — i have a failing end-to-end in billing flows when header is present; investigating whether middleware strips it. will file bug if i can't fix by EOD.
rachael: FYI sdk-queue — node has a transitive dep causing a minor semver issue with our bundler. will open PR for lockfile update.
alex: owners list for rollout doc (add to the rollout thread): SDKs — rachael; infra/canary — sam; routing/model — juan; QA — mike. if ok i'll add to the schedule and notify partners.
juan: ok from eng-ml. sam can you confirm capacity?
sam: confirmed + will reserve 2x small dedicated pods for canary, fallback route to hosted region if pods saturate.
mike: timeline ok. will run nightly smoke in canary window and post results.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/v2/2026-05-11T06:00Z -> triggered by alex. status: queued. :rocket:
rachael: one last note — docs team needs a short blurb about compat mode and migration steps. i'll draft and assign.
alex: thanks everyone. i'll publish the rollout doc after rachael posts SDK PR and mike posts initial smoke. please ping here for any late blockers. :thumbsup:
